llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文研究了SLM制备Ti-Nb合金的力学性能和生物活性，但未涉及多孔结构、应力屏蔽或疲劳性能，与用户关注的多孔植入物力学匹配和疲劳行为方向部分相关。

summary_zh.motivation: 研究Nb含量对SLM制备Ti-Nb合金性能及生物活性的影响
summary_zh.method: 通过SLM制备不同Nb含量的Ti-Nb合金，表征显微组织、力学性能及体外磷灰石形成能力
summary_zh.result: Nb含量影响相组成、硬度和耐腐蚀性，含Nb合金表现出更好的生物活性
summary_zh.validation: 力学测试和模拟体液浸泡实验

summary_en.motivation: To investigate the effect of Nb content on the microstructure, mechanical properties, and in vitro bioactivity of Ti-Nb alloys fabricated by selective laser melting for biomedical applications.
summary_en.method: Ti-Nb alloys with varying Nb content were prepared by SLM, followed by characterization of microstructure, mechanical properties, and apatite-forming ability in simulated body fluid.
summary_en.result: Nb content influenced phase composition, hardness, and corrosion resistance, and Ti-Nb alloys showed enhanced apatite formation.
summary_en.validation: Mechanical testing and in vitro SBF immersion experiments validated the properties and bioactivity.

papers.title: In-situ residual stress reduction, martensitic decomposition and mechanical properties enhancement through high temperature powder bed pre-heating of Selective Laser Melted Ti6Al4V
papers.abstract: During the Selective Laser Melting (SLM) process large temperature gradients can form, generating a mismatch in elastic deformation that can lead to high levels of residual stress within the additively manufactured metallic structure. Rapid melt pool solidification causes SLM processed Ti6Al4V to form a martensitic microstructure with a ductility generally lower than a hot working equivalent. Post-process heat treatments can be applied to SLM components to remove in-built residual stress and improve ductility. The use of high temperature pre-heating during an SLM build can assist in reducing thermal gradients, enable a more controlled cooling with the possibility to control/tailor as-built mechanical properties. In this work a high temperature SLM powder bed capable of pre-heating to 800 °C is used during processing of Ti6Al4V feedstock. The effect of powder bed temperature on residual stress formation, microstructure and mechanical properties was investigated. It was found that increasing the bed temperature to 570 °C significantly reduced residual stress formation within components and enhanced yield strength and ductility. This pre-heating temperature enabled the decomposition of α′ martensitic microstructure into an equilibrium α+β microstructure. At 570 °C the yield strength and elongation of components was improved by 3.2% and 66.2% respectively.

summary_zh.motivation: 降低SLM Ti6Al4V残余应力并提高延展性
summary_zh.method: 采用高温粉末床预热（最高800°C）进行SLM，测量残余应力、显微组织与拉伸性能
summary_zh.result: 预热至570°C显著降低残余应力，实现马氏体分解为α+β，屈服强度和延伸率分别提高3.2%和66.2%
summary_zh.validation: 通过残余应力测量和拉伸实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To reduce residual stress and improve ductility of SLM-processed Ti6Al4V by in-situ high-temperature powder bed pre-heating.
summary_en.method: A high-temperature powder bed pre-heating system (up to 800°C) was employed during SLM, and the effects on residual stress, microstructure, and tensile properties were investigated.
summary_en.result: Pre-heating to 570°C drastically reduced residual stress, enabled martensitic decomposition into α+β, and enhanced yield strength and elongation by 3.2% and 66.2%, respectively.
summary_en.validation: Residual stress measurements and tensile testing were conducted to validate the improvements.
